summary: Iteration 14: Backend + frontend testing of new Admin Page Content editor + auto-translation feature. All 9 pytest tests PASSED (public GET /api/content, 401 on unauth PUT, LLM translation to en/de/ru/ar, idempotent re-save (fast <5s = no LLM call), whitelist ignores invalid keys, settings tagline translation). Frontend admin UI (/admin → Sayfa İçerikleri) fully functional: 6 groups render, TR i18n defaults pre-fill empty fields (heroLine1='EFSANE LEZZET', menuTitle='Menümüz', etc.), Kaydet ve Çevir triggers toast 'Görsel yüklendi/Kaydedildi', file upload returns /api/files/... URL and preview updates. Visitor site correctly shows admin override in TR + auto-translated en value after language switch, and hero_image override renders /images/kumpir.jpg on home. Test data cleaned up.

verified_flows.PUT /api/admin/content admin: 200, translated:true, response.content has dessertTitle_en/de/ru/ar populated by LLM (verified: 'Test Enfes Tatlılar' → 'Test Irresistible Desserts')
verified_flows.Idempotent re-save: Same payload re-sent completes in <5s → LLM not re-invoked
verified_flows.Whitelist: Invalid keys (nonExistentKey_xyz) silently dropped, not persisted
verified_flows.PUT /api/admin/settings tagline: translated:true; tagline_en/de/ru/ar persisted in settings doc
verified_flows.Visitor EN: dessertTitle_en auto-translation shows after lang switch
verified_flows.Admin UI /admin: Session cookie via context.add_cookies works; dashboard loads
verified_flows.Admin tab admin-tab-content: Renders 6 groups (Ana Sayfa, Menü, Hakkımızda, Galeri, İletişim, Footer)
verified_flows.TR i18n defaults: Empty content keys pre-filled with UI.tr[key] (heroLine1, menuTitle, etc.)
verified_flows.Save & translate: content-save-btn shows 'Kaydet ve Çevir', triggers success toast
verified_flows.Image upload: 7 file inputs present; upload returns /api/files/cafedelnord/uploads/<uuid>.png, populates text input and updates preview

critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_content: image key values not stripped when empty — allows persisting empty-string hero_image which is fine for reset (currently used for cleanup). OK.
Prior notes still stand (non-blocking): Home.js uses lowercase fetchpriority (React warning), MenuItemCard.js has invalid tailwind font-800.
Consider server.py: TRANSLATABLE_SETTINGS logic strips before compare — but writes non-stripped values into allowed via update; minor inconsistency but harmless.

AdminContent.js save() sends UI.tr defaults for empty fields, meaning every field is always translated on first save (not just user-edited). Acceptable for MVP but wastes LLM tokens; consider only sending non-empty user-edited fields.
seed_data_creation: Admin user + session inserted directly in Mongo per /app/auth_testing.md
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. Admin content editor works end-to-end with auto-translation via Emergent LLM (gpt-5.4). Test session token still valid for 7 days for re-testing. Uses data-testid: admin-tab-content, admin-content-tab, content-group-<Title>, content-<key>-input, content-save-btn. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_content_admin.py takes ~7s (leverages cached translation on repeat runs).
